text:
Yasmin: FYI reconciliation pulled up a duplicated invoice situation for HelioMaps (acct HM-33). Two invoices for July window showed up with different totals. One is correct, the other has an inflated tax line.
Oleg: Can you paste invoice IDs and amounts?
Yasmin: INV-2024-07-2054 (canonical, $7,240.00) and INV-2024-07-2054-COPY (duplicated, $9,180.00). The COPY was emailed and paid; the canonical was also charged. Customer reported two charges to support.
Pri: Yikes. Payments? Gateway shows two charges: $7,240 (INV-2024-07-2054) and $9,180 (INV-2024-07-2054-COPY). The second has status refunded but there's a pending dispute.
BillingBot: [alert] invoice-generator: created invoice INV-2024-07-2054-COPY status:paid reason: "transform divergence" job-id: ig-job-10622
Oleg: Quick scan of generator logs. Snippet: 
```
2024-07-31T02:14:07Z INFO transform v1 start job ig-job-10622
2024-07-31T02:14:08Z WARN tax-plugin: currency-conversion delta > 0.5% for account HM-33
2024-07-31T02:14:08Z ERROR tax-plugin: rounding_op resulted in negative net_tax_adjustment = -120.00
2024-07-31T02:14:09Z INFO invoice-hash: computed hash mismatch, creating new invoice id INV-2024-07-2054-COPY
```
Oleg: That negative net_tax_adjustment is the smoking gun. The tax plugin applied a bad rounding correction after currency conversion which bumped the taxable base and produced a >$1,900 difference on the total. The dedupe/hash step treats slightly different line items as different invoices.
Kai: So two charges made. Refund happened automatically by our payment reconciler when it saw duplicate card swipe pattern? Pri, you said refunded but dispute opened by customer?
Pri: Correct. Refund issued for $9,180 but customer opened a dispute for the charge before refund settled. Finance needs to own dispute communication.
Yasmin: I've placed hold on any further automated invoice emails to HM-33 and created ACCT-7890 to track remediation. Attached logs and both PDFs.
BillingBot: [info] ACCT-7890 created by Yasmin assigned to Kai. SLA: 1 business day.
Oleg: Proposed remediation steps: 1) Flag INV-2024-07-2054-COPY as "do-not-send" and mark as refunded (manual check done). 2) Issue a customer-facing note explaining duplicate charge and refund with transaction IDs. 3) Hotfix tax-plugin to avoid negative adjustments: clamp rounding corrections to zero and add assert. 4) Run a scan across invoices-prod-2024-07 for any other invoices with computed negative_tax_adjustment. 5) Add stronger dedupe tolerance (epsilon) to invoice-hash to avoid new invoice creation for tiny rounding diffs.
Kai: I'm on customer comms. Drafting short note: "We identified an internal billing duplication for your account that caused a second charge. The duplicate charge has been refunded; we are also filing a dispute response on your behalf and will send transaction IDs shortly. Apologies for the inconvenience. — Finance"
Pri: I'll coordinate refunds and confirm dispute response template. Also exporting gateway logs to ACCT-7890.
Oleg: Pushed a small PR to clamp rounding: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/tax-plugin/pulls/2115 — adds test case for currency round-trip. Will also open invoice-generator PR to widen hash tolerance: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/invoice-generator/pulls/2116
Yasmin: For bookkeeping: create reversing journal entry for the refunded invoice and attach to ACCT-7890. Also add a note to delay auto-void logic for 24 hours when refunds/disputes present so we don't accidentally re-issue.
BillingBot: [info] ACCT-7890 updated: logs + gateway csv attached.
Kai: Customer comms sent to HM billing lead with refund tx IDs and a brief explainer. Copy saved to ACCT-7890.
Oleg: I ran a scan on invoices-prod-2024-07 as requested: found 3 other invoices with negative_tax_adjustment warnings — all drafts or unpaid; no other paid dupes. CSV uploaded to ACCT-7890.
Pri: Good. I'll keep monitoring dispute status and escalate to payments if the dispute doesn't auto-close after refund settlement.
Yasmin: Thanks all. Closing the loop once PRs merged, the hotfix is validated in staging, and ACCT-7890 is fully reconciled. :thumbsup:
